TITLE: ElevenLabs Timeline: Model & Product Release Dates

ElevenLabs launched its public beta in January 2023 with English text-to-speech and voice cloning. Early releases introduced multilingual speech models, faster voice generation, AI dubbing, and tools for long-form audio production.
The company later introduced sound effects, conversational voice agents, Scribe transcription models, and AI music generation. This timeline documents major model and product releases from the first public beta onward, including research previews, API launches, general availability, and significant platform changes.
Last updated: November 12, 2026.

## ElevenLabs release timeline

- 2024

## 2026
Date
Milestone
Nov. 12, 2026
Voice restoration expands to music . People with permanent voice loss can get free ElevenMusic access to compose and release songs in their own voices. NYU Langone Health joins 1 Million Voices, and ElevenLabs announces a partnership with Wounded Warrior Project.
Nov. 11, 2026
ElevenAI opens for free early access . The app uses Scribe v3 for dictation and meeting notes. It can capture conversations with participant consent and provide summaries and action items.
Nov. 11, 2026
Interaction Engine, Memory, and Routines are previewed . Interaction Engine handles turn-taking, interruptions, and language model selection. Memory will recall details from earlier conversations with authenticated customers. Routines will automate tasks before, during, or after a conversation. ElevenLabs also previews custom model fine-tuning for businesses.
Nov. 11, 2026
ElevenLabs Marketplace opens . Businesses can browse partner-built AI applications and contact vendors. Purchasing through existing ElevenLabs spending commitments is planned for 2027.
Nov. 11, 2026
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL becomes available in ElevenAgents . ElevenLabs and NVIDIA also announce plans for an on-premises voice agent for the Polish national e-health platform.
Nov. 10, 2026
Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live launch for recorded and realtime transcription through ElevenAPI and the ElevenLabs app. Scribe v3 improves speaker labeling and adds number-format controls and prompting with up to 1,000 keyterms. Scribe v3 Live adds realtime speaker diarization, context-aware turn detection, and multilingual mode, with availability in ElevenAgents.
Nov. 9, 2026
ElevenAgents adds workflows as code . The Python and JavaScript SDKs add a workflow builder in v2.77.0. Developers can define steps and routing in code, track changes in version control, and edit the same workflows in the visual editor.
Nov. 9, 2026
ElevenAgents Campaign Manager launches for outbound campaigns across phone calls, WhatsApp voice, and WhatsApp messaging, with scheduled follow-ups, context across interactions, calling windows, and attempt limits.
Nov. 6, 2026
ElevenMusic adds SoundCloud publishing . Creators can link a SoundCloud account and upload original tracks directly from ElevenMusic.
Nov. 6, 2026
Ads Engine adds human review . Linguists can check translated copy and dubbed audio, and creative specialists can review ad variants against brand guidelines.
Nov. 5, 2026
ElevenAgents Unity SDK launches for voice conversations with game characters, spatial audio, and agent-triggered game actions. Editor, desktop, and WebGL builds are supported. iOS, Android, and XR support is in beta.
Nov. 4, 2026
Native contact center integrations connect ElevenAgents to NiCE CXone, Genesys Cloud, Amazon Connect, and Five9, with call context and handoffs through existing contact center systems.
Nov. 2, 2026
Eleven Realtime rollout completes across all workspaces. Professional Voice Clone fine-tuning for Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo also becomes available to every workspace.
Oct. 29, 2026
SFX v3 launches in ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI with improved handling of multiple sounds in one prompt, music and vocals, and cleaner sound generation. Availability expands to every workspace on November 2.
Oct. 21, 2026
Eleven Realtime Translation launches in alpha for ElevenAPI enterprise customers, with live speech translation in more than 90 languages and a consistent chosen voice across the session.
Oct. 20, 2026
Eleven Realtime released. This is a new class of Speech to Speech models for building voice agents that sound natural.
Oct. 15, 2026
Video To Music released to generate background music from one or more video files. Videos are combined in order. Optional description and style tags influence the generated music.
Oct. 6, 2026
ElevenAgents Architect launches as an agent-building and improvement assistant that can review configurations and suggest changes through chat.
Sep. 28, 2026
Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo launch in ElevenAgents, ElevenCreative, and the API. The models improve expressive speech and voice consistency, with a low-latency Turbo variant for live conversations.
Sep. 26, 2026
Image, Video, and Template APIs launch, opening ElevenCreative image and video generation and reusable Flows templates to developers.
Sep. 21, 2026
Studio 4.0 launches in ElevenCreative, expanding Studio into an editor for video, images, speech, music, and sound effects with generative editing on the timeline.
Sep. 11, 2026
Music v2.5 launches in ElevenMusic, ElevenCreative, and the API with improved instrumentation and more detailed arrangements.
Sep. 11, 2026
Scribe v2 Medical becomes generally available through the API for batch transcription of clinical speech and specialized medical terminology.
Aug. 6, 2026
Dubbing v2 API becomes available for integrating multilingual dubbing, with transcript and translation editing and segment-level regeneration.
Jul. 22, 2026
Finetunes Music API launches, letting developers offer private music-model fine-tuning on their customers’ authorized tracks.
Jun. 15, 2026
Music v2 API becomes available with chunk-based composition plans for controlling song sections, timing, and arrangement.
May 28, 2026
Dubbing v2 launches in ElevenCreative and ElevenProductions, using the original speaker’s audio performance to retain tone and pacing across more than 90 languages.
May 26, 2026
Music v2 launches with improved vocals, instrumentation, multilingual lyrics, and section-level composition controls.
Apr. 29, 2026
ElevenMusic launches as a music listening, remixing, and creation platform built with artists, labels, and publishers.
Mar. 12, 2026
Music Finetunes launches in ElevenCreative, enabling creators to train custom music-model variants on their own authorized recordings.
Feb. 10, 2026
Expressive Mode launches for ElevenAgents with Eleven v3 Conversational and an updated turn-taking system for live voice conversations.
Feb. 2, 2026
Eleven v3 general availability ends the alpha phase with improvements to speech stability and the pronunciation of numbers, symbols, and technical notation.
Jan. 9, 2026
Scribe v2 launches for batch transcription of long recordings, with keyterm prompting and entity detection.

Date
Milestone

Milestone

ElevenLabs public beta launches with English text-to-speech and voice-cloning capabilities, powered by the early speech model later referred to as Eleven Monolingual v1.

## Frequently asked questions

## When did ElevenLabs first launch?
ElevenLabs launched its public beta on January 23, 2023, introducing text-to-speech and voice-cloning tools. The company was founded in 2022.

## When was Eleven v3 released?
Eleven v3 debuted as an alpha research preview on June 3, 2025. Public API access followed on August 20, 2025, and the model became generally available on February 2, 2026.

## How do ElevenLabs speech model versions differ from Voice Design versions?
Speech models generate spoken audio from text. Voice Design generates the voice identity used for that speech. Eleven v3 and Voice Design v3 are different model families.

## Is ElevenAgents a single speech-to-speech model?
ElevenAgents is a platform for voice and chat agents. It uses speech recognition, language models, speech synthesis, and conversation controls. The platform launched as Conversational AI before becoming ElevenLabs Agents and later ElevenAgents.

## How does ElevenMusic differ from the Eleven Music models?
Eleven Music refers to the music-generation model family introduced in August 2025. ElevenMusic is the listening and creation platform introduced in April 2026. Music v2 and Music v2.5 are later generations of the music model.

TITLE: ElevenLabs Summit NYC: The Interaction Layer for AI

AI is more capable than ever, but to make that intelligence widely accessible, systems need to be easy for everyone to understand and use. That depends on those interactions feeling natural and intuitive. ElevenLabs is building that interaction layer for AI.
At its New York Summit today, ElevenLabs introduced new models, agents, and deployment options to help businesses interact with people through AI and find new ways to generate revenue.
“Within a few years, conversational agents will become critical infrastructure for every enterprise, as essential as cloud or payments,” said Mati Staniszewski, CEO and co-founder of ElevenLabs. “Every business will need to reinvent how it interacts with its customers, employees, and the wider world.”
Here’s what ElevenLabs announced at the Summit:

## Advances in the models powering every interaction
We started with voice and built the industry’s leading models for natural conversation, and our work is now expanding to the models and tools powering all the ways people interact with technology.
Onstage, Staniszewski previewed several updates that will make interactions between AI systems, customers, and employees feel more natural and better suited to the situation. “Our mission at ElevenLabs is to solve human-technology interaction, and for the first time, it’s solvable,” he said.

## Fine-tune open-source models and ElevenLabs voice models for your domain
Every industry has its own language and norms. How you serve customers, and the best channel for that conversation, differs from one industry to the next. That’s why ElevenLabs has worked to build dedicated models for major industries. Domain-specific Speech to Text models learn the terms that industries a business actually uses, like EBITDA in finance, or HIPAA in government. ElevenLabs used this approach to build Scribe v3 Medical, a transcription model for healthcare. It can recognize thousands of complex medical terms with much greater accuracy, and captures the difference between drug names like cycloserine and cyclosporine, so a patient ends up with a tuberculosis treatment, not an immunosuppressant.
This work won’t be slowing down, and Staniszewski said that a domain-optimized model for the financial services industry is in the works. But we also believe businesses should be able to refine the models they use not just for their industry, but for their specific context and customers.
In the keynote, Staniszewski announced that in the coming months, we will help businesses fine-tune certain open-source language models, as well as ElevenLabs voice models, for their own use. “We will not solve human-AI interaction without reflecting what makes people and businesses distinctive,” he said.
Teams will be able to fine-tune models to the specific idiosyncrasies that makes their company unique. Businesses can bring their own data from their live deployments and work with ElevenLabs researchers to refine the models powering them. Each business can pick the metrics that matter to them, such as a customer satisfaction score (CSAT) or reliability, and ElevenLabs researchers will help you take data from your live deployments to fine-tune the models that power them. You can continuously optimize based on each new interaction; Staniszewski compared it to each company essentially having their own reinforcement-learning stack.
“We will continue shipping more domain-optimized models to ensure your AI is more accurate and more useful, but we also think businesses should be able to go further, with models refined not just for their industry, but for their company and customers.,” Staniszewski said. “It’s one of the best ways to make your data work for you, and extend your own unique advantage.”

## Interaction Engine orchestrates the whole conversation
Not every agentic task requires a frontier model at every step to succeed. Determining which models to use, how, and when to drive a specific outcome is an art in itself, one that ElevenLabs researchers have been working to solve.
ElevenLabs previewed a new system, called Interaction Engine, which starts with the rhythm of the conversation. It handles turn-taking and interruptions, so the agent knows when to jump in and when to stop talking. It can also pick  the right LLM for each part of an exchange. A cheaper model can handle triage, keeping token use in check, and a frontier model steps in to handle more complex tasks as needed.

## Major upgrades to ElevenAgents and more
ElevenAgents is the platform for configuring, deploying, and improving voice and chat agents across sales, support, recruitment, and operations. It understands who it’s talking to and adapts to what they need.
Customers and partners like Yahoo, Westgate, and KPN are already putting ElevenAgents to work and seeing that agents who better understand context and culture deliver better outcomes for everyone.
Staniszewski shared several updates coming to ElevenAgents that will make interactions between agents and customers more seamless and natural.

## Memory helps ElevenAgents remember returning customers
In customer support conversations, people often share valuable information that isn’t captured or acted on.  “One of the hallmarks of a great conversation with a person is that they remember what you told them and act on it. Agents should do the same,” Staniszewski said.
Memory will let an ElevenAgents agent develop a record of a customer over time, recognizing a returning authenticated customer and recalling what they said before. While the CRM remains the primary customer record, Memory captures the details shared in conversation that never had a field, things like preferences, constraints, upcoming occasions. If a customer prefers Spanish and can only talk after 5pm, the agent remembers and acts on it.
After each interaction, the agent distills the conversation into a structured record and updates it when the customer returns. It also holds on to details that matter later. A phone subscriber who mentioned he was moving in March doesn’t need to bring it up again when he calls in April: the agent automatically knows to ask whether he’d like to transfer service to the new address, and retires the old one. The result is an understanding of each customer that compounds with every conversation, so every interaction feels more personal than the last.

## Routines handle the work around conversations
Most of the follow-up work for a customer support call happens after the call ends. It’s often done by people and tools that weren’t part of the original conversation. Routines, the new automation layer in ElevenAgents, will allow users to run multi-step work before, during, and after every conversation. It connects to tools and systems your team already works in.
A Routine can pre-screen a mortgage applicant and call back within minutes, or remind patients ahead of a visit, and offer a canceled slot from the waitlist.They can also be built to email a report, write to a CRM, or start a call, all natively in ElevenAgents.
With Routines, ElevenAgents takes on more of the work around every conversation, so your team spends less time on prep and follow-up and more on customers.

## ElevenAI helps people stay present in the conversations that matter
In a sneak preview during his keynote, Staniszewski introduced ElevenAI, a new app from ElevenLabs. It functions as an AI teammate for enterprise teams; it listens to spoken conversations, including in-person meetings, and turns those into notes and next steps. If ElevenAgents is the interaction layer between businesses and customers, ElevenAI will be that layer for employees getting work done.
ElevenAI offers dictation and meeting notes powered by Scribe v3 , ElevenLabs’ newest and most accurate Speech to Text model. In meetings, it takes notes with everyone’s consent, then delivers a summary and action items for each attendee when the call ends. It can also give live assistance during a call, sharing context and enhancing collaboration between people and agents. Notice and consent mechanisms are built in, so the people on the other end feel comfortable.
As people rely on personal agents more in their daily lives, they’ll need support at work that’s built for them as employees. ElevenAI adapts to a company’s tools and processes and stays with people throughout their workday. It also passes the right context between agents and people, so the two can work together as one team. Free early access to ElevenAI is opening today.

## Expanding the enterprise ecosystem with the ElevenLabs Partner Program and ElevenLabs Marketplace
ElevenLabs’ partner network has grown to more than 550 partners in 44 countries, including Google Cloud, IBM, Deloitte, DXC, and Genesys. Today, we’re launching the ElevenLabs Partner Program to make it easier for enterprises to deploy ElevenAgents with the consultancies, systems integrators, software vendors, and agencies that already know their business. Partners handle the integrations into your existing tech stack, or work alongside ElevenLabs FDEs on complex deployments, whatever helps you realize value fastest.
As part of the program, ElevenLabs is also announcing an alliance with McKinsey , pairing ElevenAgents with the firm’s enterprise transformation expertise, and QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey. Businesses can now build on ElevenLabs, build with a partner, or buy from one to scale agents across complex systems.
Additionally, ElevenLabs and NVIDIA announced they are expanding their partnership . Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is now available in ElevenAgents, and ElevenLabs is also adding 15 MW of new Vera Rubin compute capacity. The two companies will also work on an on-premises voice agent for Poland’s national e-Health platform. The agent will work on appointment scheduling for patients who only have landlines.
Today, we’re also introducing the ElevenLabs Marketplace , a curated group of industry-specific AI and voice applications built on ElevenLabs by our technology partners, for industries including healthcare, financial services, insurance, education, and retail. Enterprises can browse agents and applications and connect directly with the partners behind them. Starting next year, businesses will be able to buy these agents through the Marketplace using their existing ElevenLabs commitment.

## What happens when interaction is solved
Staniszewski closed the keynote by asking what happens when interaction between people and AI is solved. His answer was a world where technology adapts to people, the limits of language, geography, and scale fall away, and local nuance and culture are preserved.
“People are understandably concerned that AI could centralize and homogenize everything. That businesses won’t be able to protect their moats. That each new iteration of AI regresses to the mean,” Staniszewski said. “We’re building the opposite. Models, products, and a community to amplify what makes your business unique, and help you extend your advantage.”
Today’s announcements are steps toward that future, and ElevenLabs is building it with the customers, partners, and developers who joined in New York. To get started, begin with ElevenAgents .
Written by
Mike Murphy
Blog editor and lead writer
Mike Murphy is the lead editor and writer for the ElevenLabs blog, where he turns complex research and technology into clear, compelling stories. Before joining ElevenLabs, he spent years as a technology reporter, including at Quartz, and ran content at IBM Research. He holds a master’s degree in journalism from Northwestern.

A ElevenLabs manteve um ritmo intenso de inovação e expansão entre 2025 e 2026, transformando-se de uma startup especializada em síntese de voz em uma plataforma completa de infraestrutura de IA para empresas ("interaction layer for AI").

### Principais desenvolvimentos e marcos corporativos (2025-2026):
*   **Evolução da Plataforma:** A empresa consolidou suas soluções de voz e conversação sob o ecossistema **ElevenAgents**, voltado para automatizar interações de suporte, vendas e operações em grandes empresas.
*   **Cúpula em Nova York (11 de novembro de 2026):** O marco mais recente foi a "ElevenLabs Summit" em Nova York, onde a empresa anunciou a expansão para modelos de IA empresarial, novos produtos e parcerias estratégicas.
*   **Ecossistema e Marketplace:** Foi lançado o **ElevenLabs Marketplace**, permitindo que empresas adquiram aplicações de IA criadas por parceiros, e o **Programa de Parceiros ElevenLabs**, que inclui alianças com consultorias globais como a McKinsey.
*   **Inovações em Infraestrutura:**
    *   **Interaction Engine:** Um sistema avançado para orquestrar conversas, gerenciando turnos de fala, interrupções e seleção dinâmica de modelos de IA (balanceando modelos menores para triagem e modelos de fronteira para tarefas complexas).
    *   **Memory & Routines:** Introdução de memória persistente para agentes (lembrando interações passadas com clientes) e uma camada de automação ("Routines") para conectar fluxos de trabalho antes, durante e após as conversas.
    *   **Fine-tuning Corporativo:** Introdução de recursos para empresas refinarem modelos de voz e linguagem com seus dados específicos.

### Principais produtos lançados (2025-2026):
*   **ElevenMusic:** Plataforma dedicada à criação, remixagem e audição de música, incluindo suporte a modelos de música (Music v2, v2.5).
*   **Linha Scribe:** Modelo de transcrição de alta precisão (*Speech-to-Text*), com versões especializadas como o **Scribe v3 Medical** (voltado para terminologia de saúde).
*   **ElevenAI:** Um aplicativo voltado para equipes empresariais que utiliza o Scribe v3 para realizar transcrições, resumos e extração de ações de reuniões presenciais e remotas em tempo real.
*   **Modelos de Voz:** Evolução contínua da tecnologia de síntese, com o lançamento das séries **Eleven v3** e **Eleven v4** (incluindo variantes Turbo para latência ultrabaixa).

As informações foram obtidas diretamente do blog oficial da ElevenLabs (https://elevenlabs.io/blog/nyc-summit) e de registros históricos de lançamentos da empresa (https://www.scriptbyai.com/elevenlabs-timeline/).
